description: Create a new geo target for geographic targeting. Areas is an array of objects with continent, country (2-letter code), region, city fields.

areas.description: Array of geographic areas to target

continent.description: Continent name (e.g. "North America", "Europe"). Not needed if country is provided.

inclusive.description: If true, target users IN these areas; if false, EXCLUDE these areas

range.description: Radius range for geo-fencing (only applies when targeting a city)

name: create_geo_target
